Icon definitions
Every icon definition: what an icon stands for, and the shared name icon sets map their icons to.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

An icon definition is one thing an icon stands for, such as `close` or `delete`. Every icon set registers its icons against definitions in its data file's `map`, and templates are written against definitions, so a project that switches icon sets gets the same definition from the new set. Built-in definitions, marked [built-in], are the shared names Core renders (the semantic icon names in `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs icons`); every set maps them, and `integration check` fails until it does. The others are optional: map each one your library draws. `map` keys a definition by its camelCase name, shown after the id (`eyeSlash`); `experimental icon map` and `--pairs` take either spelling. A set may add its own definitions; in a project that sets `experimental.iconSet`, they are listed here with the package that ships them. `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon <definition>` finds the icon each installed set draws for it. Icon definitions are experimental: they may change or be removed in a patch release.

Definitions

## activity (activity)

Activity or live status over time.

Words = `pulse`, `live`

An icon set registers the icon that draws this definition in its data file: `"map": {"activity": "<icon id>"}`. Find it in each installed set: `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon activity`.

Icon definitions are experimental: they may change or be removed in a patch release.
